message.content:
I need a thorough audit of the Claude Hub app at /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/claude-hub. 

The app is a management dashboard for Claude Code agents. It reads/writes .md files to disk in specific locations (.claude/agents/, .claude/commands/, .claude/rules/, CLAUDE.md).

I need you to trace every file WRITE operation (PUT, POST, DELETE endpoints in src/server.js) and check:

1. Are the correct file paths constructed?
2. Is ensureDir called before writing to potentially non-existent dirs?
3. Is base64url decoding of project IDs handled correctly?
4. Are there any path traversal vulnerabilities (e.g., if someone passes ../../../etc/passwd as agent name)?
5. Does the frontend send the right data format for each write endpoint?
6. Are there missing CRUD operations? (e.g., can you create commands/rules from the UI, or only read them?)
7. Check all frontend pages that perform writes: AllAgents.tsx, AgentEditor.tsx, GlobalAgents.tsx, GlobalClaudeMd.tsx, ProjectDetail.tsx, Settings.tsx

Read all relevant files and give me a detailed report of every issue found. Be thorough - this needs to be production-grade.
